name: Layer Kanojo wa NTR Daigaku 1-nensei
original_name: レイヤー彼女はNTR大学1年生
source:
I found the perfect girlfriend. She is cute, shy, and a full blooded otaku, just like me. Recently however, she left our hometown to enroll at the National Technical Research (NTR) University. Now we must face the challenges of a long-term relationship for the first time.

"Why is she with that man...?"
"Why does it seem like she is being trained by him.. ?"
"Why are they having sex routinely while she wears the cosplay of her favorite character..?"
They must be forcing her to this.
There is no way Alice would do this on her own. Unless..?" The innocence of youth dies hard, and the tale of a woman rises from it's ashes.
